Menu.Name: Krynn
Menu.Label: Open the Krynn settings
Menu.Hint: The age and date of the campaign, the calendar, the moons of magic and the gods.

UserCulture.Name: Calendar names
UserCulture.Hint: Whose names you see for the months and the days of the week.
UserCulture.World: My character's people, or the world's default

ShowBanner.Name: Show the sky banner
ShowBanner.Hint: A strip at the top of the screen with the date, the period and the moons.

Date.Hint: The year decides which gods answer, whether the moons of magic shine, and which orders and armies stand.
Date.YearHint: Years after the Cataclysm are positive (351 is 351 AC); years before it are negative (-1018 is 1018 PC).

Calendar.CultureHint: Each player can choose their own in the module's settings (Calendar names).
Calendar.EyeHint: The date of one night when all three moons were full together. Every phase follows from it; the Eye returns every 504 days.

MoonMagic.Label: Moon magic
MoonMagic.Hint: How strongly the moons change High Sorcery for characters with the feat Mage of High Sorcery (compendium Krynn: Magic). Applied as an effect on their sheet, each day.
MoonMagic.classic: Classic: bonuses and penalties by phase, alignments, the Night of the Eye
MoonMagic.light: Light: a bonus at High Sanction only
MoonMagic.narrative: Narrative: chat and sheet notes, no numbers

Gods.Label: When the gods are absent
Gods.Hint: What happens to the divine spells of a caster with a god in years the gods do not answer (before 351 AC, and from 384 to 420 AC). Mystics of the Heart are not affected.
Gods.strict: Strict: divine spells of an absent god fail
Gods.warn: Warn: they work, and the GM is told

Nuitari.Label: Who sees Nuitari
Nuitari.blackRobes: The GM and the Black Robes

Announce.Label: Announce the sky in chat
Announce.Hint: Post a card when a moon reaches High Sanction, on the Night of the Eye, on holy days and when the age changes.

Life.Hint: Every life a player lives in Foundry leads to this campaign. Players don't choose these; you do.
Life.Summary: Lives will lead to {year} AC, in {region}.
Life.Clamped: Lifewrought covers 1–430 AC, so the year was brought into that range.
Life.StartHint: Leave empty and the dice choose a town in the region
Life.NpcActors: The people of each life as NPCs
Life.NpcActorsHint: Besides the Chronicle journal, create an NPC actor for each person met in the life (family, mentors, rivals, loves).
Life.KrynnHeritagesHint: Kender, the elven nations, the Neidar and the clans of Thorbardin, and tinker gnomes get the heritage of the Krynn: Peoples compendium instead of a PF2e one.

HighSorcery.Label: When the moons are gone
HighSorcery.Hint: What happens to the arcane spells of mages of High Sorcery from 384 to 420 AC. Primal Sorcerers are not affected.
HighSorcery.warn: Warn: they work, and the GM is told

MoonMinLevel.Label: Moons matter from level
MoonMinLevel.Hint: The older rules left apprentices (levels 1 to 3) untouched by the moons. 1 means always.

Throes.Label: Draconians' death throes
Throes.Hint: What happens when a draconian drops to 0 Hit Points.
Throes.auto: Automatic: the card, the token changes, the acid pool on the map
Throes.card: Card only: the chat card with its damage and saves

Dragons.FearCardsHint: Post a card with the Will save for the enemies within each dragon's Dragonfear when combat starts.

Style.classic: Classic: twelve months of thirty days (360 days)
Style.kalaman: Kalaman: twelve months of four weeks (336 days)

before.Name: Before the Cataclysm
before.Text: The gods walk with their priests; Istar rises, and falls.

despair.Name: The years of despair
despair.Text: The gods are silent; false priests, hard years, and armies gathering in the east.

war.Name: The War of the Lance
war.Text: The dragonarmies march, the true gods return, and the Heroes of the Lance rise.

after.Name: After the war
after.Text: The gods have returned and the Knights are reborn; new orders grow in the dark.

chaos.Name: The Chaos War
chaos.Text: The Summer of Chaos: the Father of All and of Nothing breaks free.

mortals.Name: The Age of Mortals
mortals.Text: The gods and the moons of magic are gone; the great dragons rule, and mortals find magic of their own.

souls.Name: After the War of Souls
souls.Text: The gods have returned, and the moons of magic shine again.

Sky.Title: The sky of Krynn
Sky.MoonsAbsent: The moons of magic are gone
Sky.EyeTonight: Tonight is the Night of the Eye: the three moons stand together, full.
Sky.NuitariHidden: Only the Black Robes see the black moon.
Sky.EyeIn: The next Night of the Eye is in {days} days ({date}).
Sky.PaleMoon: A single pale moon crosses the sky. The moons of magic are gone.

yearDay.Name: Year Day
yearDay.Text: The first day of the year: gifts, and promises renewed.

darkDay.Name: Dark Day
darkDay.Text: The anniversary of the Cataclysm, kept in black and in silence.

harnkeggerfest.Name: Harnkeggerfest
harnkeggerfest.Text: Five days of the hill dwarves, opening the first keg of summer ale.

kithKanandras.Name: Kith-Kanandras
kithKanandras.Text: Honouring Kith-Kanan and the founding of Qualinesti; all peoples welcome.

silvanosdras.Name: Silvanosdras
silvanosdras.Text: The elves keep the birthday of Silvanos, who united the first elven tribes.

springDawning.Name: Spring Dawning
springDawning.Text: The spring equinox: the festival of Solace, and the Knights' contests of arms.

harrowing.Name: Harrowing
harrowing.Text: The planting season begins across Ansalon.

midyearDay.Name: Midyear Day
midyearDay.Text: The longest day: lights and dancing, and in Thorbardin the forges relit.

festivalOfCandles.Name: Festival of Candles
festivalOfCandles.Text: The dwarves remember their dead with floating lanterns.

summersEnd.Name: Summer's End
summersEnd.Text: The autumn equinox, and the start of the harvest.

festivalOfKnights.Name: Festival of Knights
festivalOfKnights.Text: A day for the Knights of Solamnia.

genealogyDay.Name: Genealogy Day
genealogyDay.Text: Gnomes file corrections to their names with the Genealogy Guild.

thanksALotDay.Name: Thanks-a-Lot Day
thanksALotDay.Text: Kender give thanks for everything that fell into their pockets this year.

yule.Name: Yule
yule.Text: The winter solstice: the Yule log is lit, and families gather before the snows.

Chat.Speaker: Krynn
Chat.Eye: The Night of the Eye: Solinari, Lunitari and Nuitari stand together, full.
Chat.High: {moon} reaches High Sanction, the strength of {robe} ({date}).

age.might: The Age of Might begins: the time of Istar.
age.despair: The Age of Despair: the Cataclysm has fallen.

period.war: The War of the Lance has begun.
period.mortals: The Age of Mortals: the great dragons come.
period.souls: The War of Souls is over.

gods.return: The true gods answer prayers again: divine magic returns.
gods.leave: The gods are gone from Krynn: divine magic is silent.

moons.return: The moons of magic shine again: High Sorcery returns.
moons.leave: The moons of magic have vanished: a single pale moon rises, and High Sorcery fails.

Welcome.Title: Welcome to Krynn
Welcome.Text: The calendar is now the Calendar of Krynn, set to {date}. Change the age, date, moons and gods in Settings → Krynn.

SelfTest.Hint: Checks that the module is set up in this Foundry and PF2e, and posts the result to the GM in chat.

Check.Calendar: The Krynn calendar is the world calendar
Check.CalendarAgrees: Foundry's date and Krynn's date agree
Check.Names: Month and day names for every culture
Check.Moons: The three moons and the Night of the Eye
Check.Languages: The languages of Krynn are registered
Check.Traits: The creature traits of Krynn are registered
Check.LifeBuild: A random life builds from this world's PF2e compendiums
Check.Packs: The compendiums of Krynn (magic, gods, peoples, backgrounds, orders, tables, creatures, dragons, relics, iconic people, atlas, guides)
Check.CastGate: Spells check the gods and the moons when cast
Check.MoonMagic: Tonight's moon magic for the three Orders
Check.LifePage: The Lifewrought page finds its files
Check.Dragons: Legacy dragons for the Dragons of Krynn window
Check.Enrichers: The Atlas's live lines and Timeline years
Check.Bestiary: Creatures with levels for the encounter generator

TraitText.kender: Small, fearless and endlessly curious folk of Krynn, related to halflings.
TraitText.draconian: Dragonmen bred from corrupted dragon eggs; each kind dies in its own way.
TraitText.aghar: The gully dwarves: the lowest of dwarvenkind, survivors of everything.
TraitText.irda: The high ogres of the far south, beautiful and secretive shapechangers.
TraitText.highSorcery: Tied to the Orders of High Sorcery and the moons of magic.
TraitText.solamnicKnight: Tied to the Oath and the Measure of the Knights of Solamnia.
TraitText.mystic: Magic of the heart, drawn from within rather than from a god.
TraitText.darkKnight: Belongs to the Knights of Takhisis (later of Neraka), the dark order sworn to the Vision of the Queen of Darkness.

Life.Title: Live a life on Krynn
Life.NoEngine: The Lifewrought engine did not load (lifewrought/engine.js).
Life.NoData: The Lifewrought tables did not load ({status}).
Life.NeedGM: Only a GM can create the character.
Life.NotFinished: This life is not finished yet.
Life.Created: {name} is ready: the character is in the Actors, and their Chronicle in the Journal.
Life.Failed: The character could not be created: {error}
Life.Queued: No GM is online. The life is saved; the character will be created when a GM connects.
Life.Timeout: The GM did not answer. Try again, or ask the GM to build it from the Lives window.
Life.Missing: {n} items were not found in this world's compendiums and were left out:
Life.ExtraDraws: The saved life ended {n} rolls early; those rolls were made again.

Page.ThreadsHint: What this life leaves for the story: secrets, enemies, debts and reasons to adventure. The player lived it; this page is for your notes.

Life.ArcaneText: On Krynn every arcane caster belongs to an order of High Sorcery or is a renegade. Add {link} to the character and choose the robes, and the moons will start to count.

Feat.MoonwiseToggle: Moonwise: about the moons or the Orders

Magic.Bonus: +{value} status bonus to spell attack rolls and spell DCs.
Magic.Penalty: −{value} status penalty to spell attack rolls and spell DCs.

Note.high: High Sanction: your moon is full. Once today you may regain one expended spell slot of a rank no higher than half your level rounded down, minus 1 (minimum 1), if you have Lunar Reservoir.
Note.waxing: Waxing: your moon grows; your magic is steady and rising.
Note.waning: Waning: your moon shrinks; your magic is steady.
Note.low: Low Sanction: your moon is dark; spells come hard.
Note.aligned: Your moon stands in alignment with another: +1.
Note.eye: The Night of the Eye: the three moons stand together, full. The Orders' great rituals can be worked tonight.

Magic.BlockedGods: {who} prays for {spell}, and no god answers. The spell fails; nothing is spent.
Magic.BlockedMoons: {who} reaches for {spell}, but the moons of magic are gone. The spell fails; nothing is spent.
Magic.WarnGods: {who} cast {spell}, a divine spell, in {year}, when the gods are absent.
Magic.WarnMoons: {who} cast {spell} through High Sorcery in {year}, when the moons are gone.

Factions.Title: Factions
Factions.Hint: Standing uses PF2e's attitudes. The GM changes it as the story goes; the player sees it here.

Finish.Title: {name}: choices to make
Finish.Text: PF2e still needs a few choices for {items}. Open the character sheet and press Finish choices: PF2e will ask for them.
Finish.NotOwner: Only the character's owner can finish its choices.
Finish.NoSource: {name} could not be found in its compendium; take it again by hand.

Throes.Title: {name}: death throes
Throes.SivakShape: The body takes the shape of {who}, the one who killed it.
Throes.Pool: In the pool (it dries up after {rounds} rounds):
Throes.Frenzy: It fights on for {rounds} rounds (Final Frenzy), then explodes.

Dragons.Title: Dragons of Krynn
Dragons.Hint: The chromatic and metallic dragons of your legacy bestiaries, brought into this world with the Krynn templates: Dragonfear, and for the Overlords the elite adjustment, Gargantuan size and the Skull Totem.
Dragons.None: No legacy dragons found. Enable the legacy bestiary in this world.
Dragons.NeedGM: Only a GM can bring dragons in.
Dragons.Imported: {name} is in the Actors, in Dragons of Krynn.
Dragons.FearText: Every enemy within {feet} feet attempts the Will save:

Atlas.GoTitle: Bring the world to this year?
Atlas.GoText: Set the world's date to the first day of {year} ({what})? The age, the gods and the moons follow.

Gen.Title: Generators of Krynn
Gen.Hint: Results go to you as whispered chat cards. Show to players reposts a card without its secrets.
Gen.Speaker: Krynn
Gen.XP: {total} XP of a budget of {budget}, for {size} characters of level {level}.
Gen.NoCreatures: No creature of this region and year was found in your compendiums at this level.
Gen.TreasureNote: Worth {total} steel in all (a steel piece is worth a PF2e gold piece).
Gen.NoTable: The Kender Pockets table isn't in the Krynn: Tables compendium.
